name: TN-02
label: Safe R

key_factors: Incumbent Tim Burchett running with large financial advantage
Prediction markets price Republican win at ~95%
No polls or expert ratings available
model.rationale: The district's R+17 lean, Burchett's incumbency and roughly six-to-one fundraising edge over Barnett, and markets pricing a Republican win at 95% all point the same way. With no polls or expert ratings to contradict the fundamentals, this stays safely Republican.
model.watch: Any late polling showing Barnett closing within single digits, or significant outside spending against Burchett, would warrant a downgrade toward Likely R.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Tim Burchett seeks another term in a Knoxville-area district that leans Republican by about 17 points. He enters the general election with a large financial advantage, having raised roughly $2.4 million and holding nearly $1 million on hand, while Democrat Michaela Barnett has raised about $400,000 with modest cash remaining. No outside groups are active in the race on either side.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the contest, so the picture rests on district fundamentals, money, and prediction markets, which give Barnett only about a 5% chance. An independent presence on the ballot is unlikely to change the outcome. The seat remains safely in Republican hands barring an unexpected shift.
